events.title: Anywhere Festival Brisbane — Final Week
events.description: Brisbane's annual festival showcasing theatre, music, comedy, and dance in non-traditional venues across the city, focusing on unique, intimate experiences. This is the final week of the festival, featuring diverse performances exploring contemporary topics.

events.title: GOMA Friday Nights — Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.cost: Free entry to gallery, exhibition ticketed
events.description: GOMA stays open late for live performances and DJs, offering a social atmosphere to enjoy drinks and food alongside the multi-sensory art of Olafur Eliasson's exhibition.

events.title: GOMA: Olafur Eliasson: Presence — Ongoing Exhibition
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: A Brisbane-exclusive exhibition showcasing three decades of Icelandic-Danish artist Olafur Eliasson's work, featuring large-scale installations playing with light, colour, and perception across GOMA's ground floor galleries.

events.title: Australian Cinémathèque: 'Double Take' Film Program
events.datetime: Mon 25 – Sun 31 May 2026 (screenings throughout the week)
events.description: An ongoing film program exploring themes of identity, fragmentation, and replication through movies featuring imposters, clones, and psychological obsessions. Screenings run throughout the week as part of a larger season.

events.title: Mogwai — Open Season 2026
events.description: Scottish post-rock band Mogwai performs a volcanic live set as part of QPAC's Open Season 2026, held in the brand new Glasshouse Theatre.

events.title: Sparks — Open Season 2026
events.description: Cult art-pop duo Sparks plays a career-spanning set at QPAC's new Glasshouse Theatre, presented as part of the Open Season 2026 program.

events.title: UQ School of Music — GHD Auditorium Concert Series
events.location: GHD Auditorium, UQ St Lucia Campus, St Lucia
events.description: A concert showcasing established and emerging student artists as part of the UQ School of Music's semester program, held in the GHD Auditorium.

events.title: UQ School of Music — Nickson Room Concert
events.location: Nickson Room, UQ St Lucia Campus, St Lucia
events.description: Student winners of Semester 1 performance prizes present their winning repertoire for piano, strings, and voice in an intimate lunchtime concert.

events.title: UQ Symphony Orchestra: Orchestral Visions — Rituals of the Street
events.location: UQ St Lucia Campus (venue TBC), St Lucia
events.description: The University of Queensland Symphony Orchestra performs a program exploring music inspired by public life, from classical salons to street rhythms, conducted by Paul Dean.

events.title: UQ Poche Centre: National Reconciliation Week 2026 Seminar Series
events.datetime: Mon 25 – Sun 31 May 2026 (check specific session dates)
events.description: A series of thoughtful public talks and discussions bringing together community, researchers, and Indigenous voices in alignment with National Reconciliation Week.

events.title: SLQ: Dearly Departed Conversations — "What Is Your Digital Afterlife?"
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: A thought-provoking conversation exploring death, legacy, and the digital world, as part of SLQ's broader Dearly Departed program. Expect a stimulating public discussion.

events.title: SLQ: Portrait of an Artist — Lindy Lee in Conversation
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: An interview screening followed by an in-conversation and Q&A session with acclaimed artist Lindy Lee, discussing her evolving practice, large-scale public works like Ouroboros, and the ideas shaping her artistic vision.

events.title: SLQ: Curator's Tours — Extraordinary Stories and Treasures of the Library
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: An intimate, guided tour behind-the-scenes of Queensland's archival collections, led by a knowledgeable curator who will unveil extraordinary stories and treasures.

events.title: Anywhere Festival: Anje West's "The Ladysinger's Record Parlour Vol. 3"
events.description: An intimate music performance by Anje West, part of her popular "Ladysinger's Record Parlour" series, taking place in a private residence in Fairfield.

events.title: Anywhere Festival: "The Bloke Agenda" — Comedy/Theatre
events.description: A sharp, topical comedy-theatre performance that critically examines the "manosphere" as part of the Anywhere Festival's final week, held in an unconventional venue.

events.title: Anywhere Festival: "Airtight" — Immersive Theatre
events.description: Matilda Award-winner Indiah Morris presents an intimate and unconventional immersive theatre experience set within a domestic space, transforming a Tupperware party into a performance.

events.title: Anywhere Festival: "Smile: The Story of Charlie Chaplin"
events.description: An intimate, 5-star theatrical production recounting the story of Charlie Chaplin, performed in a Wooloowin gallery for a small audience of 40 people.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — Ongoing Shows This Week
events.description: Catch a range of stand-up and sketch comedy performances across multiple venues as part of the ongoing Brisbane Comedy Festival, offering diverse comedic talent throughout the week.
